newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bunds to suffer from short-term profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Bunds to suffer from short-term profit taking.

text.p: German debt prices face a session of downside on Friday as traders take profits from recent hefty gains.

Analysts said that with the September contract dipping below the 103.00 level on early dealings on Friday and the Bobl and Schatz contracts breaking below previous lows on Thursday, a move to cash in profits was advisable in the near term.
"Some profit-taking in Bunds continues to be suggested," said DMG Futures and Options in a research note.
"However, any significant sell-off should still be viewed as a buying opportunity."
